verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a 'Muted' item status, which gives a mute control for noisy items. The pack has no evidence of spike protection or per-key/per-project rate limits; grouping, merging and token disabling are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: spike protection, per-key rate limits, documented mute/ignore rule configuration and how muting suppresses alerts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can fight alert fatigue with spike protection, per-key rate limits, and mute/ignore rules so one bad deploy doesn't page the whole team all night

citations.quote: There are four statuses: Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived.
